wiki.title: Glenn Grothman
wiki.extract: Glenn Sholes Grothman ( GROHTH-mən; born July 3, 1955) is an American attorney and politician serving as the U.S. representative from Wisconsin's 6th congressional district. A member of the Republican Party, he was first elected to his seat in 2014.
